name: [Č] Karlovy vary, vřídlo - Střela (lávka)
description_md:
This hard waymarked hiking route in CZ covers 51.8 km with 1207 m of ascent and 1168 m of descent. The national waymarked hiking network route takes about 16 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and is signposted as 0236.

The difficulty of the route is derived from distance and ascent. The path passes Hot Spring Colonnade, Imperial Spa, and Goethe within 100 m.
